summary: Institutional positioning is heavily skewed toward long-term bullish bets on the S&P 500, evidenced by massive accumulations in SPX 7000C contracts expiring in 2026 and 2027, totaling billions in premium. While today's SPX P/C ratio is slightly bearish at 1.13, the persistent multi-day accumulation of the SPX 7000C (over $4.2B over 4 sessions) and the massive $1.7B+ buildup in the 2026-11-20 7000C strikes signal high-conviction, long-dated upside positioning. Conversely, significant hedging is visible through the buildup of SPX 8000P positions ($1.6B over 4 sessions), suggesting institutions are buying deep OTM protection against extreme tail risk. Traders should watch for volatility in SPX and tech leaders like TSLA and META, where aggressive call buying (P/C ratios of 0.36 and 0.58 respectively) suggests a strong intraday bullish bias despite broader index hedging.
